summary: Spurs lined up in a 3-1-4-2 against Coventry City's 4-2-3-1 (5 changes from the Man Utd game, switching from 4-2-3-1).
Chances were even (0.87 xG to 0.77), so the win came down to finishing and fine margins.
On the main style measures this was a typical Spurs performance for the season: nothing moved more than 15% from their average.
Tonali was the biggest attacking threat (0.35 xG + xA).
